splittingIntoApartmentRights.scope: specified buildings containing rental/former rental housing; includes private/institutional/non-Breda-corporation housing up to 200 m2 bvo and/or housing below the applicable rent-benefit threshold as defined in article 2
splittingIntoApartmentRights.permitExpiryUseRule: permit can be withdrawn if deed/member rights are not registered/granted within one year after permit becomes irrevocable

purchaseProtection.wozCeiling: NHG threshold applicable to the WOZ value
acquisitionConditions: deed registration after entry into force of article
dwelling free of rent/use or rented less than six months or already rented under purchase-protection permit
not owned by municipality or housing corporation
purchaseProtection.mandatoryAndDiscretionaryPermitGrounds: articles 9 and 10 plus statutory grounds; includes specified family/temporary-use statutory grounds and municipal care/special-case grounds

records.operationalEvidence: 2026 leges regulation still charges for purchase-protection permit applications, confirming the permit product is operational.
productEncodingGuardrails: Do not generalize the apartment-right splitting permit to physical dwelling formation/room rental without a separate current source.

Address, ownership/use history and WOZ value remain required inputs for purchase-protection outcome.

permitRequiredFor: conversion from self-contained to non-self-contained housing
dwelling formation into two or more dwellings
housingStockChanges.corporationSpecificException: temporary conversion by housing corporations at explicit municipal request for specific target groups is exempt as provided by the regulation

splittingIntoApartmentRights.newBuildingException: no permit under article 30 when the building was delivered less than five years before 1 January of the year of splitting

acquisitionConditions: deed registration after entry into force of article
dwelling free of rent/use or rented less than six months or already rented under purchase-protection permit
not owned by municipality or housing corporation
purchaseProtection.permitGrounds: statutory mandatory grounds plus municipal purchase-for-government/care and special-case discretionary grounds

productEncodingGuardrails: Calculate 70% of the current NHG cost limit at decision time rather than storing an old fixed euro threshold.
